name: GigBAR MOVE + ILS strobe LED (part)

authors: screen-machine (hand-written from the maker's manual; not from open-fixture-library.org)

comment: One of the four cool-white strobe LEDs in the face of a Chauvet DJ GigBAR MOVE + ILS, patched as its own light so scenes can run them in order (owner, 27 Nov: "L-R or R-L or ping pong"). The bar's chart gives each LED its own dimmer (52CH: +26..+29) and the four one shared strobe (+30): mode 'led' is one dimmer, 'led-strobe' a dimmer and the shared strobe (patch LED 4 with it). docs/GIGBAR_RIG.md §1.1.

capabilities.comment: Flash: no strobe (assumed; the manual starts strobe at 000)
